title: Fan Cowl Door — Removal from the Nacelle

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of a fan cowl door from the nacelle, including the hold-open rod procedure, the hinge pin extraction sequence and the distortion measurement taken before the door leaves the aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to remove a fan cowl door from the nacelle, and the hinge station distortion measurement that must be recorded before the door is taken to the shop.
sections.job_setup_note: The door is heavy and is removed at head height. The hold-open rods must both be engaged and locked before any hinge pin is disturbed, and the door support trestle must be positioned and set to the door contour before the last pin is withdrawn. Wind limits apply: the door must not be opened above the wind speed given in the figure, because the hold-open rods are not designed for a gust load on the open door.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the engine has been shut down for the cooling period given in the figure and that the aircraft is on chocks. 2. Confirm the wind speed is below the limit for door opening. WARNING: DO NOT OPEN A FAN COWL DOOR ABOVE THE STATED WIND LIMIT. THE HOLD-OPEN RODS DO NOT CARRY A GUST LOAD ON THE OPEN DOOR. 3. Release the latches in the sequence given in the figure, aft to forward. 4. Open the door and engage both hold-open rods, then confirm both locks are made. 5. Measure the distortion at the aft hinge station with the contour gauge and record it. 6. Position the door support trestle and set it to the door contour. 7. Remove the drain line clamps and lay the line clear of the hinge. 8. Withdraw the forward hinge pin. CAUTION: DO NOT WITHDRAW THE AFT HINGE PIN FIRST. THE DOOR PIVOTS ON THE FORWARD HINGE AND WILL DROP ONTO THE TRESTLE EDGE. 9. Support the door on the trestle with two persons and withdraw the aft hinge pin. 10. Release the hold-open rods and lower the door onto the trestle. 11. Fit the hinge lug protectors and move the door to the shop area.
sections.close_out: Fit the blanking covers on the nacelle hinge fittings and the latch keepers. Confirm that the drain line is supported and not left hanging. Record the aft hinge station distortion measurement, the door serial number and the position it came from, because a converted door must be returned to a nacelle of the same standard.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Step 5 is mandatory on aircraft pre MOD-148710 and is used to rank doors for conversion.

safety_precautions: Confirm the wind speed is below the door opening limit.
Engage and lock both hold-open rods before any hinge pin is disturbed.
Position and set the door support trestle before the last pin is withdrawn.
